## Sun et al. (2019), liquid FeSiO3 2500 K BM4 reference

Identifier: `fesio3_liquid_sun_2019_2500k_bm4_1`.

Availability: **Executable**.

Values use the source model's parameter units. Primary `V0` uses
the conventional-cell volume declared above. Errors retain their reported
meaning; an absent error is unknown, and absence of covariance does not
establish statistical independence.

The full source EOS adds a specialized thermal term built from a Gaussian heat-capacity function and a volume-dependent Gruneisen parameter. That thermal form is not currently represented by the eosmat schema, so this record deliberately stores only the explicitly defined, directly executable 2500 K BM4 reference isotherm. The exact 40-state liquid selection is bundled. The paper derives Cv from energy-temperature slopes and gamma from pressure-energy slopes before fitting their volume functions; the supporting information supplies those observations only as raster plots, whose regression-line slopes are now digitized in a separate dataset. The digitization closely recovers the published Cv function but cannot recover the authors' unknown relative weighting for the gamma function. Consequently, subtracting either rounded published or digitized thermal coefficients from Table 1 and freely fitting four BM4 coefficients remains an ill-conditioned sensitivity experiment, not a reproduction of the source regression.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.

### fesio3\_liquid\_sun\_2019\_figures\_s3\_s4\_digitized

- **Description:** Regression-line slopes digitized from the original high-resolution raster TIFFs for Sun et al. (2019) supporting Figures S3 and S4, converted to Cv and gamma for the 32-formula-unit simulation cell.
- **Kind:** thermodynamic\_derivative\_digitization
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Sun; Zhou; Yin; Lu
    - **Year:** 2019
    - **Source:** Geophysical Research Letters
    - **Volume:** 46
    - **Locator:** Supporting Figures S3-S4
    - **DOI:** 10.1029/2018GL081421
- **Source location:** Supporting Information S1, Figures S3 and S4; original embedded files word/media/image9.tif and word/media/image10.tif
- **Associated EOS records:** fesio3\_liquid\_sun\_2019\_2500k\_bm4\_1
- **Uncertainty:**
    - **Kind:** digitization\_only
    - **Coverage:** Approximate one-standard-deviation pixel and line-separation uncertainty; excludes the unpublished FPMD energy uncertainty and source-fit weighting.
- **Notes:** Axis calibration used labeled major ticks in the original 5972x4213 Figure S3 TIFF and 5850x4213 Figure S4 TIFF. Colored regression-line center pixels were fitted after excluding marker neighborhoods; Cv=(dE/dT)\*96485.33212331/32 and gamma=V\_cell\*(dP/dE)/160.2176634 with 32 FeSiO3 formula units. The tabulated values reproduce the plotted line slopes, not hidden source observations.
